_comment: topuplib_meta.json file goes in your mod's folder
This file describes the specification for topuplib_meta.json
githubPath is the A/B, where A is the username and B is the name of the repository
version is optional. You may also specify maxVersion, however this is not used yet.
required: The mod is required in order to use this mod
recommended: This mod is recommended for the best baseline experience, but is not required
